title: Flying over the city
content: I dreamed I was flying over the city at night. The lights from the buildings were beautiful. Felt so free.

title: Secret room in the house
content: Dreamed I found a door in my house I'd never seen before. I opened it... it was a library with high ceilings, full of books.

title: The talking cat
content: Such a weird dream... my cat was wearing a detective hat and turned to me and said, "Let's go find some mackerel."

title: Running for the airport
content: Dreamed I was late for a flight. I kept running but could never reach the gate, and I forgot my luggage. So chaotic.

title: Indigo beach
content: Dreamed I was at the beach, but the water was a deep indigo, not blue like normal. The sand was so soft. I was walking alone, felt very peaceful.

title: Got a new dog
content: Dreamed I got a big, fluffy golden retriever. It ran up and licked my face. I was so happy I almost woke up....

title: The debugging code
content: Dreamed about the bug I've been stuck on for 3 days... Woke up, vaguely remembered the solution, ran to my computer, and it actually worked!
